estimated_ramps.name: Unmeasured post-Shoreline net-exit group at a San Antonio exit
estimated_ramps.basis: Calibration-only hypothesis: 8041 veh/h at 401507 plus 560 measured San Antonio entrance minus 5616 across four 402377 channels leaves 2985 before the missing lane. An assumed 1500 veh/h missing-lane contribution gives a rounded 1500 veh/h net-exit group. Gross ramp flows and field wiring remain unknown.

limitation: Ten predeclared calibration candidates. Initial/refined cases used 1800-second clearance; the final split cases used 7200 seconds. Selection compares the same six full-lane stations. 402377 is a separate partial-lane diagnostic.
